name: As All Falls to Emptiness
description: People describe wisdom in many different ways: an eternal garden, an imperishable monument, an ancient tree that reaches the sky. And from these they extract what they most desire: a flower, a stone, a leaf... Wisdom also seeps into every dream, for better or for worse, flowing like a stream, projecting itself as the shadow of a tree over every corner of the world. Thus, the catastrophe that lurks in dreams manifests itself... Now, it is descending.
